summary: fix(settings): tune Nova dividers, nav icons and weights in Settings
description:
Because:
- Nova dividers were darker than Figma's; nav icons, headings and the delete button were off.
- The Connected Services rule sat inset more than other section dividers, flag on or off.

This commit:
- Adds a nova:-only border-divider (currentColor at 12%) for Settings dividers.
- Leads nav external links with a 16px text-colored icon under nova:.
- Aligns the Connected Services rule with other dividers (flag-off change).
- Keeps Delete account at py-2 on mobileLandscape under nova:.
- Uses font-heading on Settings headings (700 flag-off, semibold under nova:).
